meta.title: Species and class reskins: 5e species/class -> modern-Earth display name (names and flavor only)
meta.version_file: tables/species-class-reskins.version.json (sha256, built_at, entry_count, diff); history in tables/species-class-reskins.CHANGELOG.md

id_scheme.id: id = stable kebab-case 5e id: the lower-cased species or class name from tables/chargen-5e.json / rules/30-species-supplement-5e.md, or '<parent>-<option>' for a lineage, ancestry or class option. Never changes once published.
id_scheme.stored_on_sheet: Sheets keep storing the 5e species and class (and lineage/option) as they do today; this table only changes what /create and announcements show.
id_scheme.lookup: Look up by id. For a lineage or class option, parent_id names its species or class.
id_scheme.fallback: If an id is missing, fall back to srd_name (exact, case-insensitive).

meta.display_rule: Species and lineages: display_name is just the nationality (Caleb, 2026-10-04), e.g. 'Welsh (Dragonborn)', 'Icelandic (High Elf)'; the earlier joke name is kept as long_name (and long_label, long_spoken). Show combined_label = 'Display Name (5e Name)' (label_name, when present, is the short 5e name used in the label instead of srd_name; class options only). Names and flavor only: ability scores, traits, hit dice, proficiencies, spells and every other 5e rule are untouched.

kinds.species: 9 SRD species (chargen-5e.json species) + 12 supplement species (rules/30 section 4) + 5 decision-036 Offer options (rules/30 section 4A: Primal, Sasquatch, Frost Maiden, Fairy, Doppelganger) = 26
kinds.species_variant: variants of a species: rules/30 4.2 Felid = Cat, Cat Girl, Tigran, Were-Cat; Lajabless phases Radiant and Skull (rules/30 4.7); Fairy subraces Sprite and Wisteria Fairy (rules/30 4A.4, decision 036, cosmetic); Caprid Small and Large Dark breeds and Nodling Two to Six heads (ledger R-004 / R-050 and the wiki pages, since rules/30 names no entries for them). They have base_id = the species id, rules_entry false (no separate stat block), and a rules_note. Added at Caleb's request, 2026-10-04.
kinds.species_lineage: base_id = the species id; chargen_value = the exact option string in chargen-5e.json. The sub-choices /create shows: Dragonborn ancestry (10), Elf lineage (3), Gnome lineage (2), Goliath ancestry (6), Tiefling legacy (3)
kinds.class_option: the level-1 class choices that rename a branch: Cleric Divine Order (2), Druid Primal Order (2). No level-3 subclasses are chosen in /create.

meta.nation: Real-world nationality the name plays on (null for classes). Caleb, 2026-10-04: every species, lineage and variant entry has its OWN unique nationality (no two share one), so a label never repeats a nationality; the check enforces it.
meta.tone: DCC dungeon-crawl gallows humor, affectionate, adults-only table. Real nationalities played for comedy on food, weather, folklore, sports, quirks and absurdity. No slurs, no 'lazy/dirty/violent' stereotypes. Crawlers, never the other word. Caleb, 2026-10-04: real nationalities for ALL species including Orc; no archetype swaps; no tone_risk or alt_display_name fields.
meta.source: Caleb's request of 2026-10-04 (Azerbaijani/Romanian Orc, Norwegian/Icelandic Elf, Vietnamese Dwarf named by him; rest made up by Lore). Decision-036 species names approved by Caleb 2026-10-06 10:06 AM CT.

entries.flavor: Your flag already has a dragon on it. You are the paperwork catching up. Every consonant is a threat.
Your country owns the biggest cave on Earth. Hauling a fridge on a scooter was just the warm-up.
Half your country politely believes in elves, so the paperwork was already filed. You trance through daylight that never ends.
Your cousins are bronze statues all over Wroclaw. Hypnosis bounces off a nation that survived every telemarketer.
Big-boned, big-hearted, and the front row of every scrum. Gentle until the ball is involved.
Eleven million people, countless beers, and once 541 days with no government. Statistically suspicious, deliciously.
Baseline. You apologize to the trap after it hits you, then thank it for the experience.
Your country is literally named Land of Fire. You refuse to fall down, and you refuse to refuse tea.
entries.long_spoken: Land-of-Fire Pomegranate Orc, Azerbaijani edition. Orc.

entries.flavor: You run a little hot. Everyone else calls that Tuesday in February. Horns come with a feather headdress option.
Half the coast claims a seal grandmother and you can prove it. Three accents, none of them borrowed on purpose.
In your city the cats own the sidewalks and pay no rent. You inherited the attitude and a tea glass.
Fireworks are a national art form. Yours go off on purpose, mostly, and the safety sign is in a very polite font.
Five feet of warty, leaping calm. You say nothing for hours, then throw a boot forty meters and call it a conversation.
You stand near doors for a living. Back home everything already wants to eat you, so this is a promotion.
The old stories make Nagas guardians of water and treasure. You guard the chai and the margin on it.
Skull face, goat leg, two moods. Day you is a sweet abuela. Night you is the whole party and the ofrenda.
entries.long_name: Mexican Calavera, Day Shift and Night Shift
entries.long_label: Mexican Calavera, Day Shift and Night Shift (Lajabless)

entries.flavor: Your relatives climb trees for lunch. You are polite until someone is stupid, and then you ask three pointed questions.
Your country's name literally means land of eagles. You are always above, and you insult guests only after your besa expires.
Two heads, one grill, and a permanent argument about the cut. Both heads see a therapist. Separately.
Your country sells Dracula souvenirs and you own the souvenir stand. Bite-and-heal comes with garlic sausage on the side.
Your country dug up the first raptor eggs. Now you hatched out of someone's paperwork. Quick, toothy and loyal as a herding dog.
Olduvai Gorge is where they dig up the first of us. You picked the factory settings: your old body, your old skills, nothing added.
Your country has Bigfoot museums, Bigfoot festivals and not one sharp photo. You stomp first and pose later.
Your island is mostly ice and you took it personally. You float instead of walking, and your handshake gives frostbite.
Two English schoolgirls fooled the world with paper fairies in 1917. You are the real thing, and your magic lives in your wings.
Your language named the thing, so you might as well be it. You reshape into any form within your mass, and every change hurts.
Hans Christian Andersen did the PR. You are small, fast and a lot less sweet than the stories.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Fairy (rules/30 4A.4 has one stat block). Cosmetic subrace (decision 036 and decision 025; canon R-074); no separate rules entry unless Syndicate's rules section says otherwise.

entries.flavor: Wisteria came out of China and took over every garden trellis on Earth. You bloom purple and climb whatever is nearby.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Fairy (rules/30 4A.4 has one stat block). Cosmetic subrace (decision 036 and decision 025; canon R-074, Silfa is a Wisteria Fairy crawler); no separate rules entry unless Syndicate's rules section says otherwise.

entries.flavor: The whole cat. Your ancestors were worshipped and you have not let anyone forget it.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Felid (rules/30 4.2 has one stat block). Cosmetic variant; no separate rules entry (rules/30 open question 14).

entries.flavor: Cat ears, bubble tea, and a loyalty card nobody remembers issuing. Donut has opinions, in writing.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Felid (one stat block). Cosmetic variant; no separate rules entry (open question 14).

entries.flavor: Big-cat energy through the mangrove. Boats yield the channel and so does the tide.
entries.rules_note: DIFFERS IN CANON, NOT IN RULES: canon Tigran is a big cat (ledger R-053), but rules/30 4.2 gives no separate stat block, so it plays as base Felid (size Medium or Small per the Felid table). Syndicate to confirm whether Tigran needs its own rules entry (open question 14).

entries.flavor: Furry by moonlight, rose-oil salesman by day. The village never asks which half is bluffing.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Felid (one stat block). Cosmetic variant; no separate rules entry (open question 14). Canon Were-Cat is a shifter form; no shifting rules are ported.

entries.flavor: Four feet tall and politely carrying the national happiness index. You win staring contests with mountains.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Caprid. Canon sub-type 'smallest breed, about four feet' (Caprid wiki page, Subraces, Book 8 spoiler). rules/30 4.8 allows Small size 'if you pick a small breed; DM approves', but names no breed entry. Names come from the wiki/ledger (R-004), not the supplement.

entries.flavor: Towering, dark and satanic-looking until you open your mouth and ask about the weather. Very tall country, very large goat.
entries.rules_note: Same rules as Caprid (Medium default). Canon sub-type 'large, dark, satanic-looking breed' (Caprid wiki page, Subraces, Book 8 spoiler). rules/30 4.8 'Not ported' lists it as a later subrace idea. Name from the wiki/ledger, not the supplement.

entries.flavor: Dawn bell, sunshine, spells at half price. The goat hoof wears a very nice sandal.
entries.rules_note: A PHASE, not a pick: every Lajabless alternates Radiant and Skull every 12 hours (rules/30 4.7 names Radiant Phase; ledger R-049: beautiful form, spells cost half, Strength halved). Rules are already in the base Lajabless entry. Syndicate to confirm whether the starting phase is selectable.
entries.long_label: Calypso Carnival Radiant La Diablesse (Radiant Phase)

entries.flavor: Dusk bell, skull face, strength doubled. Folklore says never follow the lady in the long dress down the road. You are the lady.
entries.rules_note: A PHASE, not a pick: every Lajabless alternates Radiant and Skull every 12 hours (rules/30 4.7 names Skull Phase; ledger R-049: skull-faced form, Strength doubled, spells cost more). Rules are already in the base Lajabless entry. Syndicate to confirm whether the starting phase is selectable.

entries.flavor: Two heads, one imperial crest, and a waltz neither head can agree to lead.
entries.rules_note: This is the version rules/30 4.10 ports (two heads; 'this is the two-head version'). Canon allows two to six heads (ledger R-050, Nodling wiki page). Base Nodling rules apply; no separate rules entry.

entries.flavor: Three heads, three bicycles, and a perfectly flat opinion about everything. The vote is always 2 to 1.
entries.rules_note: Canon head count (ledger R-050: two to six heads). rules/30 4.10 lists the 2-6 head variants as NOT ported, so the rules are those of base Nodling (two heads); Syndicate to decide whether more heads need their own entry. Name from the ledger, not the supplement.

entries.flavor: Four heads running four different splits. One of them is always ahead, and he never stops talking about it.

entries.flavor: Five heads, five palates, one cup of coffee. Dinner takes an hour and the argument takes longer.

entries.flavor: Six heads sing six sad songs about the same missing sandwich. Nostalgia has never been this loud.

entries.flavor: Black as the star on the flag, sweet as the cocoa you hoard. Breathes acid and gets a standing ovation at every wedding.
Light blue, two World Cups, and a thermos of mate you will not share. Lightning strikes whenever the referee misses a call.
Your breath is a trumpet solo at full volume. Weddings, funerals and fire drills all hire you.
Looks like a museum piece and knows it. Gestures wildly with a very expensive wing.
Mined enough copper to roof a continent and came out with jokes. All bad. All rehearsed.
Hoards gold, braais everything, and breathes acid on anyone who touches the grill. Rugby is the second religion.
Green as the hills, loud at the pub, and poisonously polite. The weather report is always a lie.
Red as the flag, proud as a llama, and fire is your idea of a spicy ceviche.
Your mountain once paid for half an empire. You breathe frost and still negotiate the price.
White as a ski slope and just as slippery. Breathes frost and eats brown cheese with a straight face.
Lives where the sun leaves in November. Builds fine furniture in the dark and refuses to read the instructions.
Precise, punctual and very high up. Your timing is perfect and the fondue is not optional.
Half the country is forest and the other half is a digital startup. You hide in either one.
Knows every edible mushroom and has argued about each one. The national sport is picking them and being right.
Invented a cube that has ruined more weekends than the dungeon. Tinkers, solves and then twists it back on purpose.
Carries the whole expedition and the tea. Lives so high the clouds say hello first.
Born on a ring of fire and unimpressed by volcanoes. Cooks dinner on the crater rim.
Drills through a lake, sits for six hours, and calls it a social event. Frost? You call it Thursday.
Runs up the hill for fun and arrives for coffee. The coffee ceremony takes three rounds and no hurry.
Your country is named for stone houses. You shrug off blows like a very old wall.
The storm is loud and so is your karaoke. Both end with everybody singing along.
Eats at 10 PM and dances until the sun files a complaint. The abyss is the after-party.
Hades was a neighbor and the family argues about it at every dinner. Plates get smashed. Souls get plated.
You grill the fire, you pickle the fire, you eat the fire. The ghost pepper asks for mercy.
Failed the course, kept the certificate, and now charges by the hour for the same thing.
Unlicensed entertainer with a Bluetooth speaker and four fans. Two of them are family.
Somebody up there signed for you. Pastoral care, triage, and a surprisingly effective hand-sanitizer miracle.
Smells like a compost bin with ambition. Has a plot, a hose, and opinions about your lawn.
Fell into it, kept falling. Checks IDs, breaks up fights, and holds a grudge about the cover charge.
Barefoot by choice. Teaches breathing, punches stress, and makes a living off Namaste and a cash-only mat.
Took an oath. Probably to the bylaws. Clipboard, shining armor, and a fine schedule for unauthorized mailboxes.
Knows which way is north. Has been told it is a rare skill. Drives a truck with a bad radio.
Your record says 'opportunist.' Your references say 'talented.' The mall says 'please leave.'
Over-charged at birth and leaking sparks into everything. Do not plug into the wall.
Clicked 'I agree' without reading. Your patron read it. Your patron has notes.
Reads. Gross. Seven years into a thesis nobody asked for, powered by bad coffee and unfunded curiosity.
Armor and martial weapons. Stands between the bleeding and the elevator.
Extra cantrip and sharper at religion. Reads a tarot deck with the price tags still on.
Extra cantrip and nature smarts. Sells heirloom tomatoes that are, technically, still cursed.
Medium armor, shield and martial weapons. Maintains the trail and slaps anyone who feeds the wildlife.
